selection_rule: Per scene: (1) statistics -> animated stat card. (3) Global assignment takes the highest (scene, clip) pairs first, each clip used once, if score >= tau=0.24. (4) If a scene's best stock score < tau+0.03 and AI is allowed, an AI image is generated and wins only if its CLIP score >= stock + 0.02. (5) Otherwise the best unused clip within 0.03 of tau, else a text card.
